from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u057/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background]
    if not marks:
        return out
    color = marks[0][2] if len(marks[0]) > 2 else None
    # Join aligned markers with the fill color while preserving the markers.
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for rr, c in marks if rr == r]
        for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            for c in range(a + 1, b):
                out[r][c] = 3
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r, cc in marks if cc == c]
        for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            for r in range(a + 1, b):
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
# remove unnecessary color assignment before writing
source=source.replace('    color = marks[0][2] if len(marks[0]) > 2 else None\n','')
path=programs/'task-2d4f0916.py'
path.write_text(source)
